basic_details.job_title: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow (Computer Science & Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Update 17 Nov 2026: A revised copy of the notice for SRDP 1420 G has been issued. The posts, eligibility, fellowship and last date of 25 November 2026 are the same, but the online application link printed in it differs by one letter from the earlier one.

age_limit.details: The age limit is 35 years and as per the norms of the Government of India / IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. Relaxation for SC/ST students is as per Govt. norms. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility under the applicable ANRF/IIT (ISM) JRF rules.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines), Dhanbad
Dynamic Model Compression and Energy-Efficient Multimodal Scheduling on Edge Devices

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: One JRF position is open. The notice sets out the following for it. Relaxation for SC/ST students is as per Govt. norms. Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, deep learning, pruning/quantization/distillation ONNX/TensorRT, NVIDIA Jetson/Linux, GPU profiling Real-time systems, optimization/scheduling and benchmarking Experience with computer vision and NLP The age limit is 35 years and as per the norms of the Government of India / IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. Relaxation for SC/ST students is as per Govt. norms. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility under the applicable ANRF/IIT (ISM) JRF rules.

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech. in Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Artificial Intelligence or a closely related discipline, with eligibility/selection criteria as prescribed in the applicable ANRF/IIT (ISM) JRF rules.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship of Rs. 42,000 in the third year will be awarded after successful assessment. The project tenure is a maximum of three years or till the end of the project, whichever is earlier. The candidate will be allowed to pursue a PhD as per the Institute norms.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF - Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice states that the JRF will: develop and evaluate compressed vision and NLP models for NVIDIA Jetson edge devices; implement ONNX/TensorRT inference engines; acquire live GPU, CPU, memory, temperature and power telemetry; design an energy-aware runtime scheduler for multimodal workloads; integrate concurrent object-detection and language-processing pipelines; measure latency, accuracy, throughput, energy per inference and scheduler overhead; conduct COCO and appropriate NLP benchmark experiments; maintain research code, datasets, experimental logs, reports and publications.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF - Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Interested candidates must fill out the online application through the link given in the notice, on or before 25 November 2026. The notice does not describe the form-filling steps in detail. All supporting documents Copies of publications Awards Recommendation letter CV with photo GATE/NET/National level examination qualification certificate, etc. The Principal Investigator's email is [email protected] and his web page is people.iitism.ac.in/tarachand/. The notice lists them as his contact details, not as an address for sending applications.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be notified of the date of the interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and the project's requirements. Mere possession of minimum qualifications does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. The interview will be conducted via video conferencing, and a link will be shared with the shortlisted candidates in due course. The interview date is not given in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad under the ANRF project?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) position of ANRF - Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under project SRDP 1420 G.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF JRF position?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 November 2026. Applications are made online through the link in the notice.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the ANRF JRF position?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech. in Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Artificial Intelligence or a closely related discipline, with eligibility/selection criteria as prescribed in the applicable ANRF/IIT (ISM) JRF rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this JRF position?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years and as per the norms of the Government of India / IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. Relaxation for SC/ST students is as per Govt. norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF?
faq.answer: The fellowship is (Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA)/month for the first two years and (Rs. 42,000 + 20% HRA)/month for the third year.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: The notice gives the fellowship as Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 + 20% HRA per month for the third year. It mentions no other allowance.

faq.question: Q7. When is the third-year fellowship of Rs. 42,000 paid?
faq.answer: The fellowship of Rs. 42,000 in the third year will be awarded after successful assessment.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit and the project's requirements. Shortlisted candidates are interviewed via video conferencing, and the link will be shared with them in due course.

faq.question: Q9. How long does the JRF project last?
faq.answer: The tenure is a maximum of three years or till the end of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Can the JRF do a PhD while working on the project?
faq.answer: The notice says the candidate will be allowed to pursue a PhD as per the Institute norms.
